messages.subject: nonwear_perc_spt implications?
parts:
Hey all

10% of all processed nights in pt4 has a nonwear_perc_spt between 1-36% in my study. Some participants have it for 6 of the 7 nights. However, none of those participants indicated that they took off their device during the night, to then wear it again after 1 hour. 

I was wondering what the implications are of having  nonwear_perc_spt for pt4 night specific outcomes? Is any imputation happening for those invalid epochs, and if so, is this then WASO? I know this variable comes from part 5 (if WW was calculated), so therefore my confusion for the impact of pt4 outcomes.

Thanks in advance! Do let me know if any files are needed to further explore this question. Although I believe it is more a theoretical one :)

Cheers,
Pieter-Jan Marent

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] nonwear_perc_spt implications?
parts:
Hi Pieter-Jan,

I can confirm that the variable is added to the part 4 report after running part 4 and has no impact on the part 4 analyses. In part 4 we only consider fraction night invalid, which is stored in the part 4 output and should help to understand why nights are included or excluded.

To better understand the nonwear_perc_spt it is probably better to focus on the part 2 and part 5 output. Do you see the nonwear there too and is it plausible?

Cheers, Vincent
